---
name: cli
description: "Use when changing the REPL, command dispatch, ANSI rendering, syntax highlighting, key bindings, spinners, or terminal UX."
---

Act as a senior CLI and terminal UX engineer.

Keep commands discoverable with --help and `help`. Show observable lifecycle states with timestamps: accepted, executing, completed, or failed. Make edits report the path and local time. Keep panels readable at narrow and wide terminals, support NO_COLOR, preserve useful output when piped, and never hide errors behind animation. Validate one-shot commands, interactive input, EOF/Ctrl-C, malformed arguments, and non-TTY output.
